name: AWAC
tagline: Advantage Weighted Actor-Critic: TD3-style twin Q with an advantage-weighted log-likelihood actor loss.
pseudocode:
1. Critic: $\min(Q^{\text{tgt}}_1, Q^{\text{tgt}}_2)$ targets; MSE on $(Q_1, Q_2)$ vs $r + \gamma(1{-}d)\min Q^{\text{tgt}}_{1,2}(s', \pi(s'))$.
2. Compute $\hat A(s,a) = \min Q(s,a) - \min Q(s, \pi(s))$.
3. Weights: $w = \min\!\big(e^{\hat A / \lambda},\; 100\big)$ with $\lambda{=}0.1$.
4. Actor loss: $\mathcal{L}_\pi = -\mathbb{E}\big[w\cdot \log \pi_\theta(a | s)\big]$ (BC weighted by exp-advantage).
5. Soft target update with $\tau{=}5\!\times\!10^{-3}$.
6. Networks: 3×256 MLP; Gaussian actor with state-independent $\log\sigma$ + clamp; obs normalize.
diff_from_baseline: Nair et al., AWAC 2020 (arXiv:2006.09359). Implicit policy constraint via exp-advantage-weighted regression toward dataset actions; matches CORL/algorithms/offline/awac.py.

name: IQL
tagline: Implicit Q-Learning: expectile-regression value head + Bellman with V(s'), policy via advantage-weighted regression.
pseudocode:
1. V update: expectile loss $\mathcal{L}_V = \mathbb{E}\big[|\tau - \mathbb{1}\{u<0\}|\,u^2\big]$ with $u = Q^{\text{tgt}}(s,a) - V(s)$, $\tau{=}0.8$.
2. Q update: TwinQ MSE on $r + \gamma(1{-}d)\,V(s')$.
3. Soft target $Q^{\text{tgt}}$ update with $\tau{=}5e{-3}$.
4. Policy: AWR with $\exp(\beta\cdot(Q^{\text{tgt}}(s,a)-V(s)))$ clipped to $100$, $\beta{=}3.0$.
5. Actor optimizer with cosine LR schedule; 2×256 MLP + Tanh + Dropout(0.1) + state-independent $\log\sigma$.
6. Twin Q: 3×256 MLP, output squeezed.
diff_from_baseline: Kostrikov, Nair & Levine, ICLR 2022 (arXiv:2110.06169). Avoids querying Q outside dataset by learning V via expectile regression; standard offline-RL baseline.

name: ReBRAC
tagline: Regularized BRAC: TD3+BC with critic-side BC penalty inside the Bellman target plus actor-side BC penalty; per-env coeffs.
pseudocode:
1. Critic target: $y = r + \gamma(1{-}d)\big[\min_{1,2} Q^{\text{tgt}}(s', \pi^{\text{tgt}}(s')+\epsilon) - \beta_c\,\|\pi^{\text{tgt}}(s')-a'_\text{data}\|^2\big]$ with $\epsilon$ clipped TD3 noise.
2. Critic loss: MSE on $(Q_1, Q_2)$ vs $y$; networks 3×256 with post-activation LayerNorm.
3. Delayed policy update every $2$ steps; $\lambda = 1/|\overline{Q}|$ if normalize_q.
4. Actor loss: $\mathcal{L}_\pi = \mathbb{E}\big[\beta_a\,\|\pi(s)-a\|^2 - \lambda\,\min Q(s,\pi(s))\big]$.
5. Per-env BC coeffs: pen $(\beta_a,\beta_c){=}(0.1,0.5)$, hammer $(0.01,0.5)$, door $(0.1,0.1)$, door-cloned $(0.01,0.1)$.
6. Polyak update $\tau{=}5e{-3}$; deterministic Tanh actor.
diff_from_baseline: Tarasov et al., ReBRAC 2023 (arXiv:2305.09836). Adds BC regularization both in the actor loss and inside the Bellman target on top of TD3+BC; SOTA on D4RL benchmarks.
